notes: GAAP city with governmental funds (General, Garbage, Police, Street, Library, Sales Tax, Debt Service, nonmajor) and proprietary funds (Electric, Water, Sewer, Care Center). Governmental lines from the Total Governmental Funds 2025 column (p6); business-type from the Totals 2025 column of the proprietary statement (p10). Care Center has a June 30, 2025 year; other funds Sept 30, 2025. Governmental roll-forward: 3,414,765 + 1,993,665 - 2,072,536 + 466,649 - 1,011,156 = 2,791,387. Business roll-forward: 14,351,551 + 8,505,027 - 7,664,654 + 544,507 - 644,987 = 15,091,444. Business-type receipts total is computed (no single total printed; printed nonoperating total 466,819 includes transfers and the ERC reversal, which are kept separate). Statement Taxes 364,474 recorded as property tax (Statement of Activities p2 shows property tax 364,474 = General 325,713 + Debt Service 38,761). Debt service 102,480 split into principal 96,889 and interest 5,591 using Debt Service fund (p19) and Fire fund (p22) schedules. Transfer cross-check: gov transfers in 466,649 (Police 200,000, Library 20,000, Sales Tax 130,698, Park 51,951, Pool 64,000) and out 1,011,156 (General 335,951, Sales Tax 675,205); General's 335,951 equals Police + Library + Park + Pool; Sales Tax out 675,205 funds Water 80,294 and Sewer 720,859 net of 125,948 Water-to-Sewer; the Sewer transfer to Sales Tax 130,698 is the Sales Tax inflow. No hidden transfers found in spending lines. Detail: General, Garbage, Police, Street, Library, Sales Tax and Debt Service from Schedules 2-8; nonmajor funds from Schedules 12 and 14 by fund (Schedule 10 combining totals left out to avoid double counting). Schedule 20 (cash receipts and disbursements compared to budget) used only for the business-type funds, since governmental funds have more detailed schedules; Water and Sewer transfers split out using the cash flow statement (p11), and the budget for those two is not shown on the split lines. Zero-amount printed lines omitted. Governmental ending_cash is the sum of all cash and certificate of deposit lines on the governmental funds balance sheet.
